title: More reliable update restarts
body: Open Design 0.22.2 improves update restarts on macOS and Windows. The app waits for the previous instance to close and keeps the waiting message visible while background work finishes. See the release notes for what to expect when upgrading from an older version.

zh-CN.title: 更可靠的更新重启
zh-CN.body: Open Design 0.22.2 改善了 macOS 和 Windows 的更新重启。应用会等待旧实例退出，并在后台任务清理期间保持等待提示。从旧版本升级时的注意事项，请查看更新说明。
